column1: # One note per line: id, points, text, then key=value fields, split by tabs. Format: https://teoyujie.org/api/notes.txt

column3: Size an air purifier by its CADR and your room
column5: why=A higher clean air delivery rate filters air faster. ENERGY STAR gives a sizing table based on an 8-foot ceiling.

column3: Avoid air cleaners that intentionally generate ozone
column5: why=The US EPA advises against using air cleaners that intentionally generate ozone in occupied spaces.

column3: Check what a water filter is certified to remove
column5: why=Filters remove different substances. The CDC says to check the specific product certification and choose for the substance of concern.

column3: Compare washing machines on the water-efficiency label
column5: why=PUB labels household washing machines with two, three or four ticks for water efficiency.

column3: Check an N95 respirator against the NIOSH equipment list
column5: why=NIOSH says approved respirators have a printed TC approval number and recommends checking its certified equipment list.

column3: Choose UV400 or 100% UV protection on sunglasses
column5: why=The US FDA says sunglasses with either label block more than 99% of UVA and UVB radiation.

column3: Check sunscreen water resistance for swimming or sweating
column5: why=The American Academy of Dermatology says water-resistance labels indicate either 40 or 80 minutes in water; reapply as directed.
